ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=x+2$ and the hyperbolic function $y=\frac{k}{x}$ intersect at point P in the first quadrant. If $OP=\sqrt{20}$, what is the value of $k$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $P(x, x+2)$,\\
since $OP=\sqrt{20}$,\\
it follows that $x^{2}+(x+2)^{2}=(\sqrt{20})^{2}$,\\
simplifying, we get:\\
$x^{2}+2x-8=0$,\\
thus, $(x+4)(x-2)=0$,\\
hence, $x_{1}=-4, x_{2}=2$,\\
since $P$ is in the first quadrant, then\\
$P(2, 4)$,\\
therefore, $k=xy=2\times 4=\boxed{8}$
